name: catalyst_tps_temporal_r2e_v1
purpose: Create a fair terpene-synthase-specific R2E benchmark distinct from the general Rhea/ReactZyme benchmarks.

source.train_snapshot: MARTS-DB v1.5, official archive dated 2025-11-24; exact project source data/external/marts_db/v1.5/reactions.csv
source.final_future_snapshot_reserved: MARTS-DB online snapshot after 2026-08-31; do not use for development or v2.1 model selection

task: reaction_to_enzyme among TPS/IDS sequences, with all v1.5-known associations masked in temporal discovery cells

identity.protein: exact amino-acid sequence plus stable MARTS/UniProt identifiers where available
identity.reaction: canonicalized substrate>>product chemistry; MARTS IDs are provenance, not the sole equality key

cells.temporal_new_pair: v2.1 enzyme-reaction pair absent from v1.5 after canonical mapping
cells.temporal_protein_cold: temporal_new_pair where the positive sequence is outside every v1.5 MMseqs2 50%-identity protein cluster
cells.temporal_strict_double_cold: temporal_protein_cold plus query reaction outside every v1.5 DRFP Tanimoto>=0.5 reaction cluster
cells.legacy_frozen_double_cold: retain the existing 50% protein-identity x 0.5 reaction-similarity frozen TPS cells as an independent no-regression cell

candidate_support: All label-free TPS/IDS protein sequences available in the target snapshot are eligible candidates. For a query, mask every association already known in v1.5; evaluate only future positives. Candidate inclusion must not depend on v2.1 performance.
positive_completion: For each retained target reaction use all v2.1 future-positive enzymes inside candidate support; untested/unannotated pairs are not asserted to be biological negatives beyond ranking metrics.

baselines.classical_authoritative: historical MMseqs2-sequence-identity x DRFP-reaction-similarity nearest-association transfer, frozen exactly as in CATALYST_OPEN_WORLD_TEMPORAL_EXTERNAL_V1
baselines.tps_internal_reference: existing frozen MARTS TPS specialist route selected without v2.1 labels
baselines.general_model_reference: already frozen general Catalyst R2E v4 restricted to identical TPS candidate support, with no v2.1-driven routing changes
baselines.contextual_external: EnzymeCAGE TPS-IOCB author data may be reported separately only after overlap/leakage filtering; it is not allowed to define this temporal benchmark

promotion_target.required: MRR and MAP non-regression plus >=5 percentage-point Hit@10 gain on at least temporal_protein_cold or temporal_strict_double_cold, and no regression on legacy frozen TPS double-cold
promotion_target.freeze_r2e_condition: If general R2E remains externally strong and TPS-specific R2E satisfies this promotion target on both the v2.1 temporal benchmark and the independent legacy frozen TPS cells, R2E may be treated as frozen except for bug fixes/runtime work.

selection_policy: v2.1 is external/confirmation evidence only. Any TPS model improvement must be selected on v1.5-derived development folds, then evaluated once on v2.1.
post_reveal_policy: Do not alter candidate support, 50% protein threshold, 0.5 reaction threshold, baseline formula, primary metric or promotion gate after v2.1 target rows/performance are read.
